concerns.text: metrics.schema.yaml REQUIRES a `breakpoint_estimate` field on every aggregated-metrics row, but no task computes a per-library-size breakpoint: T008 writes a single global `breakpoint` to analysis_report.json and T010 only says 'verify aggregate metrics ... per contracts/metrics.schema.yaml'. T010's verification cannot pass as written — either a task must populate `breakpoint_estimate` per group or the schema must be reconciled; as-is an acceptance criterion is silently unsatisfiable.

Spec commits to 'A sensitivity analysis sweeping these values over a range of task counts' (i.e., the every-10-tasks threshold swept over task counts). T009 sweeps only pruning intervals {5,10,15}; the task-count portion of the assumption has no implementing task — a dropped acceptance commitment from the spec.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Corrections vs plan.md:Constitution Check III / data-model.md:Data Flow
concerns.text: Tasks redirect checksums to data/raw/checksums.json and forbid writing state/, but plan.md and data-model.md still instruct writing SHA-256 checksums into state/projects/PROJ-975-....yaml, and the constitution's Data Hygiene section requires checksums in the state yaml `artifact_hashes` map. The tasks' correction is defensible (platform-owned state), but the plan/data-model/constitution text was never updated, leaving a direct contradiction an implementer could resolve the wrong way.

Plan specifies 4 library sizes × 2 pruning flags × 3 overlap levels; T007 runs a third pruning arm (redundancy variant) = 36 runs. The added arm is a sound response to the reviewer objection and FR-004 is preserved verbatim (no weakening), but the plan's factorial definition and SC-005 runtime budget were never updated to sanction the expanded sweep.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T004/T007 vs plan.md:Phase Ordering / data-model.md:Experiment Log
concerns.text: Plan and data-model name the per-task log data/results/metrics.csv and say analysis.py 'reads metrics.csv'; tasks write data/results/experiment_log.csv and no task produces metrics.csv. The tasks' choice matches the binding experiment_log.schema.yaml, but the plan constraint it contradicts was left stale.
